mostWorthwhile.text: Turning the lunar hypothesis into a test was the strongest passage: it distinguishes supporting an explanation from proving it permanently.

leastWorthwhile.text: The test sequence felt a little abstract because neither the prediction nor the observations were specified.

surprise.text: I liked the shift from making a world to letting its inhabitants share findings that others can check without the creator.

arbitrary.text: Combining prediction with memory to make a test had a plausible purpose, but without a concrete prediction or record the connection felt underspecified.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the prospect of inhabitants questioning and interpreting the world is interesting, though I would hope for more concrete examples of their discoveries.
